title: Bringing Tom DeLonge and Lue Elizondo to the Zanesville metal

tellings.quote: I took Tom Dong and Lou Alzando to Zanesville or to to Pennsylvania or Ohio.

plain: In 2017, two men were brought to see a piece of metal said to come from a crashed UFO, kept around Zanesville, Ohio. One was the rock musician Tom DeLonge, who started a UFO research company. The other was Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official who ran a small office studying unexplained aerial reports. Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had many UFO encounters, says he took them there himself, though he is unsure whether it was Ohio or Pennsylvania. He also names the physicist Hal Puthoff and a man named Timothy Taylor.
